{"id":1584260388,"question_id":3430,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 3 months","timestamp":1742813071,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1584260388/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Count Days Without Meetings","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int countDays(int days, vector<vector<int>>& meetings) {\n        sort(meetings.begin(), meetings.end());\n        \n\n        int start = meetings[0][0];\n        int end = meetings[0][1];\n        int available_days = 0;\n        if(meetings.size() == 1)\n            {\n                available_days = end - start + 1;\n            }\n            \n        for(int i = 1 ; i<meetings.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            if(end >= meetings[i][0])\n            {\n                end = max(end , meetings[i][1]);\n                start = min(start , meetings[i][0]);\n                available_days = end - start + 1;\n            }\n            else\n            {\n                available_days += end - start + 1;\n                //  cout<<available_days<<\" \"<<endl;\n                end = meetings[i][1];\n                start = meetings[i][0];\n                if(i == meetings.size()-1)\n                {\n                    available_days += end- start+1;\n                }\n                // available_days += end - start + 1;\n                // cout<<available_days<<\" \"<<start<<\" \"<<end<<endl;\n            \n            }\n        }\n        // available_days += end - start + 1;\n        // cout<<available_days<<endl;\n    return days - available_days;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"count-days-without-meetings","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":492}
